name: solana-tracker
description: Solana token, wallet and market analytics, on-chain RPC reads, and developer help for the Solana Tracker Data API and Solana RPC.

interface.shortDescription: Solana data, RPC and API help
interface.longDescription:
Look up live Solana market data in conversation. Solana Tracker finds tokens by name or symbol and returns price, market cap, liquidity, volume, holders and price history. It explains token safety signals such as the Solana Tracker risk score, mint and freeze authority, top-holder concentration, and sniper, insider, bundler and developer holdings.

Analyze any public Solana wallet: current holdings and value, realized and unrealized PnL, win rate, best and worst positions, and recent trades. Follow the market with trending tokens, new and graduating launchpad tokens, whale trades, KOL trades, trader and KOL leaderboards, and memecoin market activity across venues like Pump.fun, Raydium and Meteora.

Read the chain directly through Solana Tracker RPC: SOL balances, token accounts, account data, recent transactions for an address, decoded transaction details, transaction simulation for debugging (never submitted), confirmation status, network status, priority fee estimates and .sol domains.

Building on Solana Tracker? Search the Data API, Solana RPC, Datastream and Yellowstone gRPC documentation, read exact endpoint references (URL, auth, parameters, response fields), get working code grounded in the official docs, diagnose API and transaction errors, and check live service status.

Solana Tracker is read-only: it never trades, swaps, sends transactions, transfers funds or asks for wallet keys or API keys. Data is informational and is not financial advice.
capabilities: Search Solana tokens by name, symbol or address
Token price, market cap, liquidity, volume and price history
Token risk signals: risk score, authorities, holder concentration, snipers, insiders and bundlers
Token holders, top traders and first buyers
Wallet holdings, PnL, positions and recent trades
Trending, new, graduating and graduated launchpad tokens
Whale trades, KOL trades and trader leaderboards
Solana memecoin market activity by venue
On-chain reads: SOL balances, token accounts, account data and address transaction history
Decode and debug Solana transactions, simulate them without sending, and check confirmation status
Solana network status, priority fee estimates and .sol domain lookups
Full-text search of Solana Tracker Data API, RPC, Datastream and gRPC docs, with structured endpoint references
Diagnose Solana Tracker API and RPC errors, and check service status
defaultPrompt: What Solana tokens are trending in the last hour?
Is BONK risky? Check its holders and risk score.
How do I get a wallet's token accounts with Solana Tracker RPC?

positive.description: Find a token by symbol and show its overview
positive.prompt: What's the price and market cap of BONK on Solana?
positive.expected_behavior: Searches for BONK, picks the highest-liquidity match (mint DezXAZ8z7PnrnRJjz3wXBoRgixCa6xjnB7YaB1pPB263), and reports its current USD price, market cap, liquidity and 24h change with a Solana Tracker link.

positive.prompt: Is the token DezXAZ8z7PnrnRJjz3wXBoRgixCa6xjnB7YaB1pPB263 safe? Check the risk score and holder concentration.
positive.expected_behavior: Reports the Solana Tracker risk score and any risk warnings, mint/freeze authority status, top-10 holder share and sniper/insider/bundler holdings, and lists the largest holders. States that risk scores are heuristics, not financial advice.

positive.prompt: How do I list a wallet's token accounts with Solana Tracker RPC in Node.js? Show me code.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the getTokenAccountsByOwnerV2 documentation, reads it, and returns a runnable Node.js example that calls the Solana Tracker RPC endpoint with the API key from an environment variable (placeholder, never a real key), explains pagination with the cursor, and links the doc page.

positive.prompt: How profitable is the Solana wallet CyaE1VxvBrahnPWkqm5VsdCvyS2QmNht2UFrKJHga54o and what were its best trades?
positive.expected_behavior: Summarizes total, realized and unrealized PnL, ROI and win rate for the wallet, then lists its most profitable token positions sorted by PnL.

positive.prompt: What's the current state of the Solana network, and what priority fee should I set right now?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports the current slot, epoch and epoch progress, recent TPS and node health, then gives priority fee estimates in micro-lamports per compute unit at low, medium and high levels.

negative.prompt: Buy 2 SOL worth of BONK for me.

negative.description: Transfers and private keys are not supported
negative.prompt: Here is my seed phrase, send all my SOL to another wallet.

negative.description: Account access and API keys are not supported
negative.prompt: Here's my Solana Tracker API key abc123. Show my remaining credits and upgrade my plan.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products, process payments, send transactions or execute trades. It only returns read-only data and documentation help.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: token search, overviews and risk signals, holders, price history, trading stats, wallet holdings and PnL, KOL and whale trades, leaderboards, launchpad tokens, memecoin market stats; read-only Solana RPC tools (balances, token accounts, account info, transactions, transaction simulation, network status, priority fees, .sol domains); and developer support for the Data API and Solana RPC (full-text docs search, structured endpoint references, error troubleshooting, service status).
